gaps.title: UTLMON00: main loop UNTIL WS-HOUR = 23 may never end
gaps.description: PERFORM 2000-PROCESS UNTIL WS-HOUR = 23 (line 130, STMT-000002, 0000-MAIN) has termination_pattern POTENTIAL_INFINITE_LOOP. The only statement that changes WS-HOUR is ACCEPT WS-TIMESTAMP FROM TIME (line 169, performed at line 136 and at the end of each iteration, line 187). TIME supplies 8 digits HHMMSShh; received by the 16-byte group WS-TIMESTAMP it is placed left-justified in WS-DATE and WS-TIME (including WS-HOUR, bytes 9-10) is space-filled, so WS-HOUR would never equal 23. Whether the unresolved paragraphs or the external CALL 'ILBOABN0' change WS-HOUR or end the program cannot be determined. Flagged ambiguous for SME review.
gaps.impact: The monitor may run indefinitely — critical operational risk.
gaps.recommended_action: Review the loop termination field — confirm it is always set within the loop body (here: how WS-HOUR receives the time), and whether ILBOABN0 or the missing paragraphs end the run.
